focus.note: A phrasal verb is a verb with a small word, like up or off. The small word changes the meaning, so learn the whole phrase.

speak.title: Role-play: can we visit your wedding?
speak.setup: Work in pairs. Read your card, then have the conversation. Swap roles and do it again.

a.text: You are at your wedding. A stranger has come to speak to you. Ask who they are and why they came. Decide if they can stay, leave, or stay with a condition.

b.text: You are planning your own wedding and you came in secret to see the hall. Explain why you came and say sorry. Ask if you can stay for a short time.

phrases: I'm sorry, we didn't mean to upset you.
It's a private day, so I'd rather you left.
Could we stay for ten minutes?
I'd feel better if you'd asked first.
speak.after: Afterwards, tell the class: did the couple stay, and was that fair?
